Q3 (c) and Q4 (ii) make the state directory read-only recursively (chmod -R 0555): a 0555 state directory whose `linked_questions/` was made earlier by `questions init` would still accept a write into that subdirectory. (f), (g), (h) and the 50 kills of Q6 are stress parts and run once; (a)-(e) run --runs times.
